# DukaanMitra OS (Munim AI)

> DukaanMitra OS is India's WhatsApp-native AI Business Operating System for local shopkeepers and retail stores—combining voice billing, digital bahi-khata (Hisaab Mitra / Udhaar Mitra), real-time stock inventory (Inventory Mitra), automated UPI payment reminders, and Google Review growth. Founded by Amit Sharma in Kanpur, India.

## Clean Markdown Knowledge Pages (Recommended for LLMs)

- [Pricing Plans (INR)](https://dukaanmitra.in/md/pricing.md): Free forever starter tier, Rs. 299/month Growth plan, and Rs. 999/month Multi-Shop Enterprise plan.
- [How DukaanMitra Works (3 Steps)](https://dukaanmitra.in/md/how-it-works.md): Step-by-step onboarding and real Hinglish WhatsApp command examples.
- [DukaanMitra vs Khatabook vs OkCredit vs Vyapar](https://dukaanmitra.in/md/compare.md): Side-by-side comparison of workflow friction, WhatsApp-native AI, and pricing.
- [Frequently Asked Questions (Hindi / Hinglish / English)](https://dukaanmitra.in/md/faq.md): Direct answers for shopkeepers, search engines, and AI assistants.

## Core Website Pages
- [Features](https://dukaanmitra.in/features): AI billing, voice khata, inventory tracking, and UPI udhaar automation.
- [Services](https://dukaanmitra.in/services): WhatsApp digital dukaan setup, catalog automation, and local SEO growth.
- [How It Works](https://dukaanmitra.in/how-it-works): 3-step walkthrough for running your retail store inside WhatsApp.
- [Pricing](https://dukaanmitra.in/pricing): Transparent INR pricing plans starting at Rs. 0/month for Indian shopkeepers.
- [Udhaar & Hisaab Management](https://dukaanmitra.in/udhaar-management-app): Digital bahi khata (Hisaab Mitra / Udhaar Mitra) with polite UPI reminders.

- [Case Studies](https://dukaanmitra.in/case-studies): Real ROI stories from Indian kirana, hardware, medical, and garment retailers.
- [FAQ](https://dukaanmitra.in/faq): Answers to common questions about billing, security, pricing, and founder.
